semantic_fragments.content: For clause 8.5.2.1: PATIENT CONNECTIONS of F-TYPE APPLIED PART shall be separated from all other parts by the equivalent of one MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION for a WORKING VOLTAGE equal to maximum MAINS VOLTAGE, and shall comply with the limit for PATIENT LEAKAGE CURRENT at 110% of maximum mains voltage. Results referenced in appended Table 8.7 and Table 8.8.3.

For clause 8.5.2.3: A connector on a patient lead or patient cable located at the end remote from the patient, with a conductive part not separated from all PATIENT CONNECTIONS by one MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION for a WORKING VOLTAGE equal to MAXIMUM MAINS VOLTAGE, must meet the following: (1) cannot be connected to earth or hazardous voltage while PATIENT CONNECTIONS are in contact with PATIENT; (2) conductive part of connector must not come into contact with flat conductive plate of not less than 100 mm diameter; (3) CLEARANCE between connector pins and a flat surface is at least 0.5 mm; (4) conductive part pluggable into a mains socket must be protected from contact with parts at MAINS VOLTAGE by insulation with CREEPAGE DISTANCE of at least 1.0 mm, 1500 V dielectric strength, complying with 8.8.4.1; (5) required test finger must not make electrical contact with conductive part when applied against access openings with a force of 10 N. All sub-requirements marked N/A because no patient leads are present.

For clause 8.5.3 MAXIMUM MAINS VOLTAGE: For other INTERNALLY POWERED ME EQUIPMENT (not single-phase mains powered, not poly-phase), the maximum mains voltage is 240 V. This sub-clause is marked as Pass (P) for the PT9L device.
